record.original_question: If G is a subcubic bipartite graph with no 4-cycle, must its strong edge-chromatic number satisfy chi_s(G) <= 7?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 31 ([81]). If G is a graph with ∆ = 3, then the following six bounds hold. ... (e) χ_s(G) 6 7 if G is bipartite with no 4-cycle.
If G is subcubic and bipartite and G has no 4-cycle, then χ_s(G) 6 7. This is Conjecture 31(e), due to Faudree, Schelp, Gy´arf´as, and Tuza.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G = (V, E) be a simple graph. A strong edge-coloring of G is an assignment of colors to the edges of G such that any two edges that are either adjacent (share an endpoint) or joined by an edge (i.e., have endpoints connected by an edge of G) receive different colors; equivalently, edges at the same color class form an induced matching. The strong chromatic index χ_s(G) is the minimum number of colors required for a strong edge-coloring of G.

A graph is subcubic if every vertex has degree at most 3, bipartite if its vertex set can be partitioned into two independent sets, and contains no 4-cycle if it has no cycle of length exactly 4.

Question: Is it true that for every subcubic bipartite graph G containing no 4-cycle, χ_s(G) ≤ 7?
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture, attributed to Faudree, Schelp, Gyárfás, and Tuza (1990), appears to remain open. Recent surveys and papers on strong edge-coloring of subcubic graphs (e.g., works on list strong edge-coloring of (sub)cubic graphs from 2024 and surveys on the strong chromatic index) still cite this as a conjecture and discuss only partial progress for various subclasses, without reporting a resolution.

status_evidence.title: List strong and list normal edge-coloring of (sub)cubic graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses conjectures of Faudree, Gyárfás, Schelp, Tuza on strong edge-coloring of subcubic graphs as still-active research.
status_evidence.claim: Conjectures of Faudree et al. on subcubic strong edge-coloring remain a reference point for ongoing work.

status_evidence.title: Strong chromatic index of graphs: a short survey
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discusses Faudree-Schelp-Gyárfás-Tuza conjectures on subcubic graphs including the bipartite no-4-cycle case.
status_evidence.claim: The bound χ_s(G) ≤ 7 for subcubic bipartite graphs without 4-cycles is listed as an open conjecture.

status_evidence.title: The Strong Chromatic Index of Graphs (Faudree, Schelp, Gyárfás, Tuza)
status_evidence.snippet: Original paper containing the conjectures on strong chromatic index for subcubic graphs in various subclasses.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture originates here and has not been reported as resolved.
